ValidationRule.description: Not allow Projected First Pay Date field to be updated on WX Assets
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(NSP_Projected_First_Pay_Date__c), RecordType.DeveloperName = "NSP_Asset_Product", NOT( OR( CONTAINS( $Profile.Name , 'System Admin' ) , $Profile.Name = "Data Migration", $Profile.Name = "Sales Administrator", $Profile.Name = "Integration User" ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You don't have permission to update Projected First Pay Date on WX type assets.
